baby-driver.packagingNote: Front cropped from official package artwork; printed blue Blu-ray + Digital banner retained. Inside scan advertised on DVDcover but inaccessible without membership. No visible watermark on selected crops. No reconstructed artwork. Front panel resampled to the requested 135:171.5 aspect without adding or repainting content.
